profile.name: HDAWG 任意波形发生器
profile.description: Zurich Instruments 的 HDAWG 高密度任意波形发生器，用于实验中输出高速可编程模拟波形，并通过外部参考时钟、AWG 通道和 DIO/码字接口与其他设备同步。该驱动包含默认设置加载、外部时钟确认、实时波形上传以及 DIO/AWG 调试可视化等功能，常用于量子控制等精密时序实验。
profile.description_en: The Zurich Instruments HDAWG is a high-density arbitrary waveform generator used to produce high-speed programmable analog waveforms and synchronize with other instruments via an external reference clock, AWG channels, and DIO/codeword interfaces. This driver supports loading default settings, ensuring external clocking, real-time waveform upload, and DIO/AWG debug visualization, commonly for precision timing applications such as quantum control.
